outcome: The project list and project journey read from the live API
acceptance_criteria: `/projects` on the live backend lists the projects the signed-in person may see, as returned by `GET /api/v1/projects?status=active` — verify: sign in as live-lead, open `http://127.0.0.1:4970/projects`; the Network panel shows `status=active` and no `limit` on the request; rows match `curl` of the same URL.

All I can see sends `status=all`, Closed sends `status=closed`; Active is the page default — verify: click each tab, read the request; the address shows no `status` for Active, `?status=closed` for Closed.

Search sends `q` trimmed, never empty, never longer than 120 characters — verify: type a name, one request has `q=<name>`; clear it, the next has no `q`; paste 200 characters, request `q` length is 120 or less (unit test of `buildProjectsQuery`).

A row with null `manager` shows "No manager"; null `reviews` / `exceptions` show Unknown, not 0; a row with `reviews: 0` shows 0 — verify: mock fixture rows from the example above; `tests/projects.test.tsx` asserts all three.

The list has no NEXT MILESTONE column, no count badges on the status tabs, no "N PROJECTS" total and no rows-per-page choice; with `next_cursor` set it shows "N shown, more available" and "Show more" appends the next page — verify: `tests/projects.test.tsx` and page at 1440 and 390 wide on the mock.

List error states: 401 shows the signed-out state, 403 the not-open state, 500 / 422 / network the error card with Retry that reloads, empty list and empty search show the texts under SCR-22 — verify: mock scenarios in `tests/projects.test.tsx`.

`/projects/{case_id}` for a project the person can see shows the title, client crumb, route line, facts strip and work rows from live `GET /api/v1/projects/{case_id}` — verify: live-lead opens a project from the list; values equal the `curl` body (`oa.py live GET /api/v1/projects/{case_id} 3` for the shape).
A title without " · " shows the whole title and no client crumb — verify: `tests/projects-model.test.ts` on `clientOf`, and the mock variant.

The facts strip has exactly four cells (CONTRACT STAGES, WAITING ON PEOPLE, STOPPED, NEXT MILESTONE); with `finance: null` the finance cells read "Not available" and no cell reads 0 for an absent value; with `finance.limited: true` "Figures may be partial." appears; INVOICES VERIFIED and PAID never appear — verify: `tests/projects-journey.test.tsx` for the four fixtures.

Work rows show line title, reference (only when not null), "Started ·  Updated" dates, and one neutral tag with the `state` words as given; changing a state's words changes no colour; the link goes to `/work/{id}` with the integer id — verify: `tests/projects-journey.test.tsx` (tag class is neutral for "Waiting", "Version 2" and an unknown word; `href="/work/12"`).

With `next_page` set, "Show more" reads `?page=2`, appends rows, keeps focus on the first new row, and a failed second read keeps the first rows and offers Retry — verify: `tests/projects-journey.test.tsx`.

"What is next", Tola's summary text, the "Station n of m" line, and line count do not appear; the "Ask me about this project" link appears only when `assistant[]` is non-empty and the person has the Assistant destination, and goes to `/assistant` without any POST — verify: test asserts no request to `/api/v1/assistant/conversations`.

Wrong person / other tenant: 403 and 404 both show "You can’t open this project" with no title, id or server message; a project id that does not exist shows the same — verify: live-none opens a UUID from live-lead's list in the browser; the mock no-access id in both `P-0099` and its UUID form (`tests/projects-journey.test.tsx`).
401 on the journey shows the signed-out state with the current tab's path as the return path; 500 shows the error card and Retry reloads — verify: `tests/projects-journey.test.tsx`.

The tab bar shows only keys in live `tabs[]` that the frontend routes, in the returned order, without counts; the Delivery tab is absent from the bar; a person whose `tabs[]` lacks `money` sees no Money tab — verify: `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx` with a reduced `tabs[]` fixture.
`/projects/{case_id}/delivery` shows "Delivery is not available yet" and no rows or mock text — verify: `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx` or `e2e/project-tabs.spec.ts` on the mock.

The Milestones, Documents, Money, Registers and Actions tabs still load their v7 mock content for a project opened by UUID, and by `P-0101` — verify: `e2e/project-tabs.spec.ts` and `tests/tab-frames.test.tsx` pass on the mock.

The mock list and journey bodies validate against the live contract for every persona and state, and `case_id` values are UUIDs; a deliberately invalid fixture (a non-UUID id, or an extra required field missing) makes the test fail — verify: `npx vitest run tests/mock-live-projects.test.ts`.

No file under `frontend/src` still reads `operations['E-PROJECTS']` or `operations['E-PROJECT']` for these two screens, and no code in `ProjectsList.tsx` or `ProjectJourney.tsx` reads `pm`, `stage`, `needs_person`, `stopped`, `next_milestone`, `counts`, `total`, `lines`, `tab_counts`, `agent_summary` or `next` — verify: `grep -rn "E-PROJECTS\|E-PROJECT'" src/features/projects` returns nothing for the list and journey modules; typecheck and lint pass.

The state words, counts or dates are never inferred: a unit test shows `factText`-style helpers return "Not available" for null and never "0" for null, and `reviews: null` renders Unknown — verify: `tests/projects-model.test.ts`.

On the design engineer's mock (ports 3000/3001 are not touched): the lane's mock server on 4971 shows the list, the journey, the empty list, the no-manager row and the Delivery "not available" state for design review — verify: open `http://127.0.0.1:4971/projects` and `/projects/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101` (Playwright `e2e/projects.spec.ts` covers both).

risk.rationale: Medium. No money, migration or write, and both screens are built, but the project read is shared by every project tab and by the work-row links, and the mock shape change touches the v7 project fixtures that the tabs still use (frontend/src/features/projects, model.ts, useProject.ts, mock fixtures). Surfaces: ui (list, journey, tab bar), api and contract-change (live operations replace v7 ones, mock validated against the contract), product-decision (dropped parts and the readings of B-1 and B-32). Product acceptance is required because what people see changes: counts, next milestone, summary and Delivery content are gone or marked not available.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
